column1: # Questions whose answer is a set of nodes, so it can be scored by code instead of by taste.
# The gold answer is what the graph query engine returns for `gold_op(gold_args)` — the
# deterministic answer DepWeaver would give. Used by PureLlmBaselineTest to compare
# "pure LLM reading the report" against the grounded pipeline.
# Note the asymmetry this creates and keep it in the write-up: arm C is given the result
# of exactly this query, so it should win on these questions. What the comparison measures
# is how far the ungrounded arms fall short of an answer the graph can settle, and what
# they name that does not exist.
